Notification.MessageBody:
We are running on a special schedule today to support ongoing service recovery near Union Station.


Please visit “See Schedules” to view modified trip times and to plan ahead. While we work to provide you with consistent service, we recommend allowing yourself extra time to get to where you are going..


To help us manage the flow of customers and to make your trip commute smoother, please listen to announcements at your station. Platform information will be posted as soon as it becomes available. Please check departure boards before heading to your platform.


Staff are on-site at Union Station to assist. Please follow their directions and listen for all announcements. 


Thank you for your understanding as we work to get you where you need to go. We know it's been a challenging commute and we appreciate your continued patience as our teams work to safely return service to normal.


Stay in the know! Sign up for customized On the GO Email Alerts. You will receive detailed updates for GO train and/or GO Bus service delays, cancellations, new schedules, service improvements, construction and other important news that may affect your trip. To sign up, click here.
